creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Board-only commits are about a fifth of the commits on main across the maintainer's repos, and a worker's card move in a linked worktree lands as an uncommitted change in the main checkout. Storing cards in a tree under a ref such as `refs/kan/board` fixes both while keeping one board per repo.

Starting sketch in `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Deferred". Open: `kan sync`, merging boards across machines, the file watcher in `kan serve`, migrating from `.kan/`, and keeping plain files the default.
title: Design: keep a repo's board in a git ref instead of .kan/ on main
